ContextMenuRoot.description: Holds the context menu's open state and shares it with the parts inside it. It is a `MenuRoot`. Renders no element.

props.open: Whether the menu is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the menu.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the menu is open at first, when it isn't controlled. Default: false.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new state after the browser or a part opened or closed the menu.
props.disabled: A disabled context menu doesn't open, and the browser's own menu shows instead.

ContextMenuTrigger.description: The area that opens the menu: on a right-click at the pointer, on a long press at the finger, and on the context-menu key or Shift+F10 below the focused element inside it. It holds the empty, fixed-position element the popup is anchored to. The area isn't focusable itself.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the menu is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the context menu is disabled.

ContextMenuPopup.description: The menu: a `MenuPopup`, an element with `popover="auto"` and the `menu` role, placed below and to the right of the point it opened at. A submenu's popup is also a `ContextMenuPopup`, declared inside its parent's.

props.side: Which side of the point the popup sits on. The browser flips it when it doesn't fit.
props.align: Which way from the point the popup extends, along the side.
props.sideOffset: The gap between the point and the popup, in pixels.
props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the side from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the point the popup is on: the `side` asked for, then the side the browser placed it on once open.

ContextMenuItem.description: An action in the menu: a `MenuItem`. Choosing it runs its `onClick` and, by default, closes the menu.

props.disabled: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it. Default: false.
props.closeOnClick: Whether choosing the item closes the menu and every menu it is nested in. Default: true.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.

ContextMenuLinkItem.description: A menu item that is a link: a `MenuLinkItem`. Enter follows it.

props.closeOnClick: Whether following the link closes the menu. Default: false.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.

ContextMenuCheckboxItem.description: An item that toggles a setting on and off: a `MenuCheckboxItem`. Choosing it leaves the menu open by default.

props.checked: Whether the item is checked. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control it.
props.defaultChecked: Whether the item is checked at first, when it isn't controlled. Default: false.
props.onCheckedChange: Called with the new state when the item is chosen.
props.disabled: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it. Default: false.
props.closeOnClick: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: false.

dataAttributes.data-checked: Present when the item is checked.
dataAttributes.data-unchecked: Present when the item is not checked.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.

ContextMenuRadioGroup.description: Groups radio items and holds which one is chosen: a `MenuRadioGroup`.

props.value: The value of the chosen item. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group.
props.defaultValue: The value chosen at first, when the group isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the item's value when a radio item is chosen.

ContextMenuRadioItem.description: An item that chooses one value of its radio group: a `MenuRadioItem`. Choosing it leaves the menu open by default.

props.value: The value the item stands for in its group.
props.disabled: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it. Default: false.
props.closeOnClick: Whether choosing the item closes the menu. Default: false.

dataAttributes.data-checked: Present when the item is the group's chosen one.
dataAttributes.data-unchecked: Present when another item, or none, is chosen.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.

ContextMenuGroup.description: Groups related items: a `MenuGroup`. A `ContextMenuGroupLabel` inside it names the group.

ContextMenuGroupLabel.description: A label for its group: a `MenuGroupLabel`, which the group's `aria-labelledby` points at.

ContextMenuSeparator.description: A line between items or groups, with the `separator` role: a `MenuSeparator`.

ContextMenuSubmenuRoot.description: A menu inside the context menu: a `MenuSubmenuRoot`. It holds a `ContextMenuSubmenuTrigger` and the submenu's own `ContextMenuPopup`. Renders no element.

props.open: Whether the submenu is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the submenu is open at first, when it isn't controlled. Default: false.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new state when the submenu opens or closes.
props.disabled: A disabled submenu doesn't open. Default: false.

ContextMenuSubmenuTrigger.description: The item that opens the submenu: a `MenuSubmenuTrigger`. It opens on hover, on a press, and on ArrowRight, Enter and Space.

props.disabled: A disabled trigger doesn't open its submenu. Default: false.
props.openOnHover: Whether resting the pointer on the trigger opens the submenu. Default: true.
props.delay: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the submenu opens, in milliseconds. Default: 100.
props.closeDelay: How long after the pointer leaves, other than towards the submenu, before it closes, in milliseconds. Default: 0.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the submenu is open.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the trigger has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the trigger is disabled.
